mapper.sql: r.support_chat_room_id, r.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.email AS user_email, r.assigned_admin_id, a.nickname AS assigned_admin_nickname, r.status, r.last_message_at, r.assigned_at, r.closed_at, r.created_at
FROM support_chat_rooms r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.user_id = r.assigned_admin_id
mapper.select: SELECT r.support_chat_room_id, r.user_id, r.assigned_admin_id, r.status, r.last_message_at, r.assigned_at, r.closed_at, r.created_at FROM support_chat_rooms r WHERE r.support_chat_room_id = #{roomId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE support_chat_rooms SET status = 'ASSIGNED', assigned_admin_id = #{adminId}, assigned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE support_chat_room_id = #{roomId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'BOT')
UPDATE support_chat_rooms SET status = 'WAITING' WHERE support_chat_room_id = #{roomId} AND status = 'BOT'
UPDATE support_chat_rooms SET status = 'BOT' WHERE support_chat_room_id = #{roomId} AND status = 'WAITING'
UPDATE support_chat_rooms SET status = 'CLOSED', assigned_admin_id = NULL, closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE support_chat_room_id = #{roomId} AND status <> 'CLOSED'
mapper.select: SELECT m.support_chat_message_id, m.support_chat_room_id, m.sender_type, m.sender_user_id, s.nickname AS sender_nickname, m.content, m.created_at FROM support_chat_messages m LEFT JOIN users s ON s.user_id = m.sender_user_id WHERE m.support_chat_message_id = #{messageId}

SELECT m.support_chat_message_id, m.support_chat_room_id, m.sender_type, m.sender_user_id, s.nickname AS sender_nickname, m.content, m.created_at FROM ( SELECT * FROM support_chat_messages WHERE support_chat_room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY support_chat_message_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) m LEFT JOIN users s ON s.user_id = m.sender_user_id ORDER BY m.support_chat_message_id
